title: WPMS/521/2010 of M/S SHREE JAGDAMBA OIL CARRIER Vs INDIAN OIL CORPORATION LTD and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Interim Relief Application No.2535 of 2010
In
Writ Petition No. 521 of 2010 (M/S)
M/s Shree Jagdamba Oil Carrier 390, Avas Vikas Roorkee, District
Haridwar through its proprietor Sri Gajay Singh.
 ......Petitioner.
Versus
Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. and two others.
 .......Respondents.
Mr. Manish Arora, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. V.K. Kohli, Senior Advocate with Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for the respondents.
Dated: -15-04-2010
Hon'ble B.S.Verma, J.
 Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the
record.
 By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has sought a
writ in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to
maintain the supply to the petitioner regularly for carrying the oil for
transportation from dispatching points to receiving points of
respondents in accordance with the contract agreement.
 According to the petitioner, as per the agreement Clause
9(c)(1) that " In case of quantity shortage of Ms/HSD/Branded Fuels,
etc, recovery shall be made at the retail-selling price at dispatch
location or receiving location, whichever is higher and transport
charges for the shortage quantity".
 Learned counsel for the respondent has drew attention of
this Court that the show cause notice was issued to the petitioner on
28-01-2010 instead of filing the objections, the petitioner has filed this
writ petition.

2
 During the course of arguments, learned counsel for the
petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the writ petition with liberty
to file objections against the show cause notice dated 28-01-2010.
 Permission granted.
 The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to
file objections within a period of seven days from today, if the
objections are filed the respondents authority shall decide the
objections preferably within a period of eight weeks from the date of
production of certified copy of this order in accordance with law as per
contract agreement.
 Interim relief application stands disposed of accordingly.
